'''Robert Israel "Bob"<ref name="ams">[https://www.ams.org/journals/notices/202305/noti2688/noti2688.html?adat=May%202023&trk=2688&galt=none&cat=interest&pdfissue=202305&pdffile=rnoti-p772.pdf American Mathematical Society Memorial Tribute for Robert I. Jewett]</ref> Jewett''' (December 14, 1937 – July 30, 2022)<ref name="obituary">[https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/bellinghamherald/name/robert-jewett-obituary?id=36181139 Robert's Obiturary]. Retrieved 2023-08-07</ref> was an American mathematician and one of the namesakes of [[Hales–Jewett theorem]]. He researched harmonic analysis, ergodic theory, differential equations, and combinatorics.<ref name="wwu">[https://news.wwu.edu/in-memoriam-robert-i-jewett WWU In Memoriam: Robert I. Jewett]</ref>

==Professional career==
After graduating from the [[California Institute of Technology]] and obtaining his PhD in mathematics from the [[University of Oregon]], he taught as a professor of mathematics at [[Western Washington University]] for 40 years until he eventually retired in 2010.<ref name="wwu"/>
